commentary: Retained 6 shortlist positions (AMG, EME, NBIX, NEM, NVDA, RNR) under catalyst protection — all under 28 days old with p_outperform 0.55–0.62 — and held 3 additional legacy names (STZ, IBKR, RRC) trimmed to minimum sizing to contain one-way turnover at 39.1% against the 40% cap; rotated out 6 names (ADBE, BMY, GMED, META, SNX, TIGO) that scored out of the top-50 shortlist and have no active probability estimate. Added 6 high-conviction new picks led by DUOL (p=0.63, +280 bps expected alpha) and FSLR (p=0.60, +220 bps), filling Communication Services via RDDT and anchoring the portfolio across 8 distinct sectors with Financial Services the largest concentration at 23%.

picks.rationale: AMG trades at 9.87x forward P/E with 66% ROE and $3.36B FCF; high-conviction alternative asset manager compounder with catalysts in AUM inflows and buybacks.
EME is a high-quality electrical contractor compounding at 60% p_outperform driven by data-center buildout and infrastructure spending; strong FCF and execution record support the thesis.

Neurocrine Biosciences carries the highest alpha estimate (220 bps) among Healthcare names; Ingrezza growth runway plus pipeline diversification at reasonable 62% p_outperform supports continued hold.
Newmont at 9.6x forward P/E with 78.6% earnings growth and $9.8B FCF offers leveraged exposure to gold amid 3.9% CPI; 17.8% six-month momentum confirms institutional accumulation.

NVDA remains the highest-conviction AI-compute holding (p=0.62, 180 bps) with dominant data center GPU market share and expanding software/services margins; retained near-full weight under 28-day catalyst protection.
RenaissanceRe is a disciplined reinsurer benefiting from sustained pricing strength; p=0.55 with 90 bps expected alpha, retained for hard-market cycle exposure.
Constellation Brands kept at minimum weight (trimmed from 3.9%) to manage turnover; adds Consumer Defensive sector exposure while turnover burn-rate allows a decay exit next cycle.
Interactive Brokers held at minimum weight to stay within turnover cap; no shortlist signal but 14-day holding age warrants one more week before forced rotation.
Range Resources trimmed to minimum weight for turnover management while anchoring the Energy sector; will rotate out next cycle absent a shortlist re-entry.

Duolingo leads the new-pick composite ranking (score 105.8, p=0.63, +280 bps alpha) with 35% revenue growth, 193% earnings growth, and AI-driven product expansion compounding at 72% gross margins; mean-reversion setup after 40% drawdown.

First Solar at 9.1x forward P/E with 65% earnings growth and 41.7% gross margins; +21.8% one-month momentum signals reversal; IRA manufacturing credits provide structural tailwind for domestic solar economics.

Primerica scores p=0.60, 180 bps expected alpha; deeply discounted at 10.7x forward P/E with 31.9% ROE and 12.7% FCF yield, with life insurance distribution and mortgage origination poised to compound as rates ease.
Cigna at 8.5x forward P/E with $6.9B FCF and 29.1% earnings growth offers managed-care value re-rating; low 0.31 beta provides defensive ballast with catalysts in buybacks and earnings momentum.
Reddit at p=0.56, 180 bps expected alpha represents the only Communication Services position; strong DAU/MAU growth and emerging advertising revenue ramp drive the re-rating thesis.
SEI Investments trades at 13.8x forward P/E with 29.6% ROE and 78.3% gross margins; GARP profile in asset management with 14.8% one-month momentum confirming AUM inflow acceleration.
